name: SynapseTech
description: Level up your game with SynapseTech's cutting-edge peripherals.
story: SynapseTech is a leading Singaporean developer of high-performance gaming peripherals. We believe in pushing the limits of technology and human potential. Motorsports provides an ideal proving ground for our products and aligns with our core values of precision, speed, and innovation, allowing us to showcase our brand to a passionate and tech-savvy audience.
